Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class RecipeAndFuelGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.RecipeAndFuelGameTests
public final class RecipeAndFuelGameTests extends Object
Recipe coverage plus the Fabric furnace-fuel path. FuelValuesMixin makes an eligible lava-holding bucket report as fuel and gives it a lava-bucket burn duration.
